sentences.cn_text: 第二次世界大战是现代西方社会高等教育发展的分水岭。
sentences.en_text: World War II was the watershed event for higher education in modern Western societies.

sentences.cn_text: 战后这些社会的高等教育入学率水平与战前数十年大致相同，一直保持在相关年龄组的3%-5%左右。
sentences.en_text: Those societies came out of the war with levels of enrollment that had been roughly constant at 3%-5% of the relevant age groups during the decades before the war.

sentences.cn_text: 但战后，成功战胜法西斯主义所引发的重大社会和政治变革使得欧美经济体对具有中等教育以上学历的毕业生需求日益增长。
sentences.en_text: But after the war, great social and political changes arising out of the successful war against Fascism created a growing demand in European and American economies for increasing numbers of graduates with more than a secondary school education.

sentences.cn_text: 而且，这些社会对接受高等教育的需求扩展到了战前从未考虑过上大学的群体和社会阶层。
sentences.en_text: And the demand that rose in those societies for entry to higher education extended to groups and social classes that had not thought of attending a university before the war.

sentences.cn_text: 这些需求导致高等教育体系从20世纪60年代开始迅速扩张，并在70年代和80年代快速发展（尽管发展并不均衡）。
sentences.en_text: These demands resulted in a very rapid expansion of the systems of higher education, beginning in the 1960s and developing very rapidly (though unevenly) during the 1970s and 1980s.

sentences.cn_text: 高等教育的增长至少以三种截然不同的方式表现出来，这些方式又分别引发了不同的问题。
sentences.en_text: The growth of higher education manifests itself in at least three quite different ways, and these in turn have given rise to different sets of problems.

sentences.cn_text: 首先是增长速度：在西欧许多国家，高等教育学生人数在20世纪60年代的五年内翻了一番，到70年代中期又在七年、八年或十年内再次翻番。
sentences.en_text: There was first the rate of growth: in many countries of Western Europe, the numbers of students in higher education doubled within five-year periods during the 1960s and doubled again in seven, eight, or 10 years by the middle of the 1970s.

sentences.cn_text: 其次，增长显然影响了整个教育体系和各个院校的绝对规模。
sentences.en_text: Second, growth obviously affected the absolute size both of systems and individual institutions.

sentences.cn_text: 第三，增长体现在相关年龄组中进入高等教育机构就读的比例变化上。
sentences.en_text: And third, growth was reflected in changes in the proportion of the relevant age group enrolled in institutions of higher education.

sentences.cn_text: 这些增长表现形式各自带来了其特有的问题。
sentences.en_text: Each of these manifestations of growth carried its own peculiar problems in its wake.

sentences.cn_text: 例如，高增长率对现有的治理结构、管理结构，尤其是社会化结构造成了巨大压力。
sentences.en_text: For example, a high growth rate placed great strains on the existing structures of governance, of administration, and above all of socialization.

sentences.cn_text: 当一个学院或系在三四年内从五名成员增长到二十名成员，而新加入的教职员工主要是刚完成研究生学习的年轻男女时，他们在很大程度上就会定义该学院的学术生活规范。
sentences.en_text: When a faculty or department grows from, say, five to 20 members within three or four years, and when the new staff are predominantly young men and women fresh from postgraduate study, they largely define the norms of academic life in that faculty.

sentences.cn_text: 如果研究生群体也快速增长，而教师与学生之间紧密的师徒关系不复存在，那么学生文化就会成为新研究生社会化的主要力量，从而对院校的学术和知识生活产生影响——这种现象在美国以及法国、意大利、西德和日本都曾出现过。
sentences.en_text: And if the postgraduate student population also grows rapidly and there is loss of a close apprenticeship relationship between faculty members and students, the student culture becomes the chief socializing force for new postgraduate students, with consequences for the intellectual and academic life of the institution — this was seen in America as well as in France, Italy, West Germany, and Japan.

sentences.cn_text: 高增长率增加了学术创新的机会，但同时也削弱了在稳定或缓慢增长时期教师和学生被纳入学术共同体的形式和过程。
sentences.en_text: High growth rates increased the chances for academic innovation; they also weakened the forms and processes by which teachers and students are admitted into a community of scholars during periods of stability or slow growth.

sentences.cn_text: 在20世纪60年代和70年代，欧洲大学的治理安排发生了显著变化，初级教员以及在一定程度上学生也获得了权力。
sentences.en_text: In the 1960s and 1970s, European universities saw marked changes in their governance arrangements, with the empowerment of junior faculty and to some degree of students as well.
